threat_event: Ransomware on the shop laptop encrypts the synced Jobs folder and the VMC program share and steals customer drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner works in an administrator account; sync is the only backup; flat network; remote-support tool; USB sticks; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-01 files; SYS-05 VMC; BP-01 and BP-02
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R02 (SC.L1-b.1.x; SI.L1-b.1.xiii); C-DIB-R04 (52.204-21(b)(1)(x), (xiii)); Aerospace PO terms (72-hour notice); OEM SQA (NDA)
existing_controls: Disk encryption; built-in antivirus; automatic OS updates; 30-day file versions
treatment_plan: Separate backup the laptop cannot overwrite, with a test restore; standard user account for daily work; network separation; security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: Payment fraud: a spoofed or compromised account redirects a customer payment or tricks the owner into paying a fake supplier invoice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the accounting SaaS administrator; email MFA by text message; bank-detail changes not verified by phone; a spoofing attempt on an OEM in 2026-05
existing_controls: Email MFA (text message); the OEM verified the 2026-05 request by phone
treatment_plan: Turn on app-based MFA for accounting and email; password manager; tell customers in writing that bank details never change by email; verify any change by phone to a known number

threat_event: The shop loses the aerospace award because it cannot show FAR 52.204-21 compliance and a current CMMC Level 1 (Self) status and affirmation in SPRS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clause never reviewed since 2025-03; several of the 15 requirements not met; no CAGE code or SPRS access; Level 1 allows no POA&M
treatment_plan: Close every FAR 52.204-21 gap (P03); run the Level 1 self-assessment; obtain a CAGE code and SPRS access; enter results and affirm as affirming official; keep artifacts 6 years

threat_event: Customer drawings (OEM confidential and aerospace FCI) are disclosed through open sharing links or email to outside processors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sharing links default to anyone with the link and never expire (27 open); full drawings emailed to processors; no flowdown or NDA with processors
treatment_plan: Close open links; default sharing to named people with 30-day expiry; send processors only the PO and spec callout; flow down FAR 52.204-21 and an NDA to any processor that must see an aerospace drawing

threat_event: Malware or an attacker reaches the VMC controller through the flat network or the service technician's laptop, stopping the machine or altering programs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VMC controller software no longer updated; VMC share without a password; visitors on the same Wi-Fi; service laptop connects directly
existing_controls: Router blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; laptop firewall
treatment_plan: Separate wired segment for laptop and VMC; guest Wi-Fi for visitors; share password; service technician connects only after the owner scans his media or uses the shop's own stick

threat_event: A released program for an OEM part is changed without approval (edited at the controller, wrong version restored, or altered by malware) and nonconforming parts ship
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No read-only master or compare before running; controller edits leave no record; SQAs require approval of process changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 controllers; SYS-01 program files; OEM parts (BP-01, BP-02)
regulatory_driver: OEM SQA (no change to released processes without approval); CSF 2.0 benchmark (PR.DS-01)
existing_controls: First article and final inspection; OEM receiving inspection
treatment_plan: Read-only Released folder with file hashes; compare before each OEM run; controller edits saved back and recorded on the traveler; OEM approval before any released-program change

threat_event: An attacker uses the IT technician's remote-support tool or account to reach the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unattended access was on until 2026-08-12; the technician's own account security unreviewed
treatment_plan: Owner starts and watches each session; confirm the technician uses MFA on the tool account; remove the tool when not in use

threat_event: Customer drawing content entered in the consumer AI assistant is kept or used for model training outside any NDA, or AI-written G-code crashes a machine or makes a bad part
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer terms; training on by default; one OEM drawing uploaded and aerospace drawing notes pasted; no review rule for AI G-code
treatment_plan: Training opt-out; delete chats with customer content; no customer information in consumer AI; AI G-code only after CAM simulation and a dry run (P10)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can reach systems, customers, or records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA codes on one phone; no emergency access sheet or overflow arrangement
treatment_plan: Sealed emergency access sheet with the designated emergency contact; written overflow arrangement with a nearby shop, subject to customer approval; backup contact for each main customer (P05)

threat_event: The laptop retired in 2025, or a discarded USB stick, exposes old customer drawings and programs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sanitization procedure; old laptop in a drawer; sticks thrown away as they are
treatment_plan: Wipe the old laptop (encrypt then reset) or use a recycler that certifies destruction; destroy old sticks; record each disposal

threat_event: A hurricane or flood closes the shop for days and damages machines or records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single site; machines cannot be moved; paper records on site
existing_controls: Cloud files reachable from anywhere; property insurance
treatment_plan: Storm checklist: scan open travelers, take the laptop, raise records off the floor, power down machines, tell customers early

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized in time, or a customer notice deadline (72 hours aerospace; 5 business days OEM) is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; notice terms spread across POs and SQAs
regulatory_driver: Aerospace PO terms (72-hour notice); OEM SQA (5-business-day notice)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; printed contact list; walkthrough with the IT technician

threat_event: Non-public customer information is seen by visitors or posted publicly (drawings on the bench, website part photos)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No visitor log or escort rule; no review before posting; an aerospace part photo was on the website until 2026-08-12
treatment_plan: Visitor log and escort rule; cover drawings when visitors arrive; check photos before posting; quarterly website review

threat_event: A drawing package with CUI or ITAR markings arrives and is handled like ordinary work (stored in the general file plan, pasted into AI, sent to processors)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intake screening rule; the shop has not registered with DDTC and cannot protect CUI
existing_controls: Aerospace customer states in writing that it sends no CUI or ITAR data
treatment_plan: Screen every drawing package for CUI, ITAR, EAR, and distribution markings before download or quoting; decline or return marked data and tell the customer

threat_event: The productivity suite is unavailable or the owner is locked out (outage or lost phone)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for email and files
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); machines run from controller memory; customer portals hold drawings
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Recovery codes go on the emergency access sheet (R-009)
